mapper.select: select @rownum := @rownum+1 as rowIndex,PBC_PROD_ID, PROD_ID, MDATE, CUS_YEAR_YIELD, ccy, CUSTOM_PROFIT, CUSTOM_PROFIT_CNY, pbcProdIdPrd, mdatePrd, cusYearYieldPrd, ccyPrd, customProfitPrd, customProfitCnyPrd from ( select dat.PBC_PROD_ID, dat.PROD_ID, dat.MDATE, dat.CUS_YEAR_YIELD, dat.ccy, dat.CUSTOM_PROFIT, dat.CUSTOM_PROFIT_CNY, prd.PBC_PROD_ID as pbcProdIdPrd, prd.MDATE as mdatePrd, prd.CUS_YEAR_YIELD as cusYearYieldPrd, prd.ccy as ccyPrd, prd.CUSTOM_PROFIT as customProfitPrd, prd.CUSTOM_PROFIT_CNY as customProfitCnyPrd from PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_END_SUB_DAT dat left join ( SELECT ifnull(t2.pbc_code,temp1.PBC_PROD_ID) as PBC_PROD_ID, temp1.prod_id as prod_id, temp1.status as status, temp1.MDATE as MDATE, temp1.CUS_YEAR_YIELD as CUS_YEAR_YIELD, temp1.ccy as ccy, temp1.CUSTOM_PROFIT as CUSTOM_PROFIT, temp1.CUSTOM_PROFIT_CNY as CUSTOM_PROFIT_CNY FROM PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_END_SUB_NEW temp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON temp1.prod_id = t2.inside_prod_id ) prd on dat.prod_id=prd.prod_id and prd.status = '01' where dat.DAT_ZIP_CODE = #{datZipCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by dat.PROD_ID asc) a,(select @rownum:=0) b
